thread:
Maya: Quick sync — Carmine Industries case study is ready for legal/quote approvals. Recording + draft here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeF (please comment). Aim to publish next Thursday and run a webinar the same week. Need final hero quote and logo permission. @Zane can you confirm customer ok for logo + 30-min webinar?
Liam: Copy. Can we get three candidate hero quotes from the customer? Marketing needs them by Tue EOD.
Zane: On it. Spoke with their CPO last week, they'll likely ok a quote about 3x inference cost reduction. I'll ping them now and get confirmation.
Priya: For webinar registration routing — can we add registrants to SFDC Campaign "Carmine-Webinar-May" and sync to HubSpot? @Casey can you own the mapping and contact flow?
Casey: I can. Need UTM and funnel steps. Proposed UTM: utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=carmine_case. I'll create the campaign & list and share access.
Ava: Need high-res logo + two screenshots (dashboard + perf graph). @Zane pls request assets and brand guidelines from Carmine.
Sofia: Send me the quote text and the exact name + job title for attribution. Also attach the signed media release form. Legal will only push back on PII or disallowed competitive contract numbers.
Zane: Sharing a short quote draft from their CPO: "Redwood cut our per-token inference cost by 62% while improving tail latency — critical for us." They want to soften the percent to "around 60%" — is that acceptable?
Liam: We can use "about 60%". Also would like to include the latency metric: "99th percentile latency improved from 400ms to 120ms." Need these verified before publish.
Casey: Where did the latency numbers come from? @eng-ml team needs to confirm the benchmark source and timeframe.
Maya: Zane — please confirm exact numbers with Carmine Ops. If they prefer "around 60%" we can add a parenthetical "(customer reported)". Legal — that's usually acceptable.
Sofia: Fine if labeled as customer-reported, but I need the signed release explicitly permitting metric publication. I'll drop a checklist in the doc.
launch-bot: Calendar event created: Webinar — "Carmine & Redwood: Cutting inference costs" on 2026-05-14 10:00 PDT. Invite sent to speakers.
Priya: Routing notes: registrants -> Marketo list "Webinar-Carmine-2026-05-14"; Sales follow-up: assign to Priya for MQLs. Also create a nurture drip for no-shows.
Zane: Carmine legal requests 24-48 hours to approve final quote & numbers. Scheduling their review for Tue morning.
Liam: Draft blog excerpt for review (please annotate inline in the doc):
"Working with Redwood, Carmine Industries reduced inference spend by ~60% while lowering 99th %-ile latency from 400ms to 120ms — enabling faster transaction times and a better user experience."
Maya: Target publish Thu EOD, webinar Wed. If legal delays, fallback: publish blog without exact numbers and run webinar as a product/tech panel with anonymized figures.
Ava: Mockups for blog + webinar slides will be ready Tue noon. Figma link: https://figma.com/file/Example (I'll share access).
Casey: Quick technical appendix request — can we publish a short config blurb: "4x A100, 16k context, quantized int8, batching enabled"? Need eng sign-off to avoid revealing infra IP.
Sofia: Technical appendix is fine at a high level. Remove internal autoscaling/obs details. Anything that reads like a runbook should be redacted.
Zane: Carmine provided logo + signed release (uploaded to the doc). They approved "about 60%" and confirmed the latency numbers. File: carmine_release_signed.pdf attached in doc.
Maya: Perfect. @Sofia please run a final read; once you sign off we can schedule publish. Also confirm quote attribution format: "Alex Chen, CPO, Carmine Industries".
Sofia: I'll review tonight and drop redlines in the doc. If no blockers, I approve for publish.
Liam: I'll queue the blog in CMS and set publish date. Also prepping social copy. Tweet draft: "Carmine Industries cut inference costs by ~60% with Redwood — live case study + webinar next week. Register: [link]" Thoughts?
Priya: Add CTA linking to enterprise demo request and ensure webinar registrants are pushed to the SFDC campaign. Add speaker list (Alex + Redwood eng lead).
Maya: Small next-steps checklist: Zane confirm final quote (Tue AM); Sofia legal sign-off (Tue evening); Ava assets + designs (Tue noon); Liam queue publish (Wed); Priya SFDC/HubSpot routing ready (Wed). If anything slips, fallback to anonymized metrics. :thumbsup:
Liam: Also setting UTM tracking for emails and social. Suggested link template:
`https://redwood.ai/case/carmine?utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=carmine_case`
Zane: I'll follow up with Carmine now and post updates here. Thanks everyone.
